title: Small ball probabilities and Chung's law of the iterated logarithm for Gaussian Volterra processes with power-type kernels
summary: Consider the Gaussian Volterra process introduced by Mishura and Shklyar \cite{MS22a,MS22b}, $$ X(t) = \int_0^t r^α\left( \int_r^t u^β(u-r)^γ\,du \right)dW_r, \qquad t\ge 0, $$ where $$ α>-\frac12, \quad γ\in\left(-1,-\frac12\right), \quad H:=α+β+γ+\frac32>0. $$ We obtain two-sided estimates for the small ball probabilities of $X$. As applications, we prove Chung's laws of the iterated logarithm (Chung's LILs) at every fixed point $t>0$, at the origin, and at infinity.
